business_knowledge.description: Permanent business principles from completed experiments.

principles.principle: Painters do not respond meaningfully to curiosity-led outreach about quote follow-up.
Trust and shared experience are stronger opening mechanisms than curiosity for trade business owners.
principles.evidence: Curiosity-led = 0 replies. FF1 (founder-to-founder) launched as hypothesis.

principles.principle: Customers do not buy because we follow up. They buy because they become more confident.
principles.evidence: 5-stage journey designed around emotional progression, not email cadence.

principles.principle: Never trust a green tick. Every claim of external effect must be independently verified.
principles.evidence: 172 emails reported as sent, 0 in Gmail Sent folder.
